description: Look up a Warhammer 40,000 detachment by name. Returns the detachment ability, available enhancements, associated stratagems, and (11th Edition only) its Detachment Points cost, eligible Force Disposition(s), and any other detachment(s) it's mutually exclusive with (e.g. Chaos Space Marines' Murdertalon Raiders and Nightmare Hunt cannot both be used in the same army).

game_mode.description: Edition: defaults to '40k_11e'. Pass '40k_10e' for 10th Edition detachments, '40k'/'40k_11e' for 11th Edition (current default).

name.description: Name or partial name of the detachment to look up

name: lookup_detachment
